<!--
Use a conventional commit title in plain language, such as "fix(pool): finished sign-ins are no longer lost".
Solve one underlying problem. Split independent fixes into their own PRs.
-->

## Problem

<!-- Explain the problem in a sentence or two. Include the expected behavior, and
reproduction steps or the environment where they matter. -->

## Change

<!-- Explain how this fixes the problem. If it spans components (router, pool Worker,
pool app, carried patches, deployment, architecture), explain why each one changes
for the same fix. -->

## Scope

<!-- Write "Tracked in #<n>" for the ticket this belongs to. Never use close, fix or
resolve, so merging doesn't close the ticket before its acceptance is proven. Name
the decisions it implements, with their issue links. -->

## Verification

<!-- Describe the focused checks you ran and what you observed for the changed
behavior. State anything you could not check, such as live behavior that needs a
deploy. "Tests pass" alone is not enough.

For UI changes, include clear before/after screenshots, and a short recording when
motion, timing or interaction matters. Upload them to GitHub and embed or link them
here. Never commit PR-only assets. -->

<!-- End with the model and harness that did the work. -->

Model and harness: <!-- e.g. Claude Opus 5.5 in Claude Code -->
